decisions.choice: answering: responding to the situation, the leaders' wish to arrest him (21:45-46)
decisions.reason: No one has asked a question. The word often means simply "spoke up" in reply to what had happened.

decisions.choice: in parables: by way of parables, the manner of his teaching
decisions.reason: Only one parable follows. The plural describes how he taught, as in 13:3 and 22:1.

decisions.choice: telling stories; He told this one
decisions.reason: Readable says what parables are and introduces the one story that follows.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic presents kept as presents at Literal; speech keeps its own tenses at every level
decisions.reason: As in John, Mark and Luke, and in Matthew 11: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading, while Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers now meet stories. This holds for the whole passage, including 22:15-22.

decisions.choice: mifano (L, B); hadithi (R)
decisions.reason: "Mfano" is the Swahili word for a parable, a story that compares; "methali" is a proverb. Readable says "stories", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 22:1-22; "그분" (L), "예수" (B, R) in the narrative; historic presents kept only at Literal
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters; respect for Jesus is carried by -시- and 께서 (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "비유" explained once at Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 12:1: Readable keeps the word and says what a parable is.

decisions.choice: "ngụ ngôn" (L, B); "câu chuyện" (R) for parables
decisions.reason: As settled for the Gospels and in 21:33; the narrator still calls Jesus "Ngài" and his speaking "nói".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: a span on every pronoun for God or Jesus, as in English
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic. This holds through the passage.

decisions.choice: "दृष्टान्त" at every level
decisions.reason: As in 13:3 and 21:33: the established word for a parable, kept at every level through the book.

decisions.choice: "答えて" (L); "答えられた" (B); "答えられました" (R)
decisions.reason: No one has asked a question; Jesus answers the leaders' wish to arrest him (m1). Japanese keeps "answer" at every level, as the English does, and the honorific form for Jesus in narration.

records.literal_gloss: Has become like the kingdom of the heavens to a man, a king, who made a wedding feast for the son of him.

en.L: "The kingdom of the heavens has become like a man, a king, who made a wedding feast for his son.
en.B: "What happens in the kingdom of heaven can be compared to this: a king prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
en.R: "The kingdom of heaven is like this. A king gave a big wedding party for his son.

es.L: «Ha llegado a ser semejante el reino de los cielos a un hombre, un rey, que hizo una fiesta de bodas para su hijo.
es.B: «Lo que sucede en el reino de los cielos se puede comparar con esto: un rey preparó un banquete de bodas para su hijo.
es.R: «El reino de los cielos es así: un rey hizo una gran fiesta de bodas para su hijo.

fr.L: « Le royaume des cieux est devenu semblable à un homme, un roi, qui a fait un festin de noces pour son fils.
fr.B: « Voici à quoi l’on peut comparer ce qui se passe dans le royaume des cieux : un roi a préparé un banquet de noces pour son fils.
fr.R: « Le royaume des cieux ressemble à ceci. Un roi a organisé une grande fête de mariage pour son fils.

sw.L: "Ufalme wa mbinguni umekuwa kama mtu, mfalme, aliyemfanyia mwana wake karamu ya arusi.
sw.B: "Yanayotokea katika ufalme wa mbinguni yanaweza kulinganishwa na hili: mfalme mmoja aliandaa karamu ya arusi ya mwana wake.
sw.R: "Ufalme wa mbinguni uko hivi: mfalme mmoja alimfanyia mwanawe sherehe kubwa ya arusi.

vi.L: "Vương quốc thiên đàng được ví như một người kia, là một vị vua, đã làm tiệc cưới cho con trai mình.
vi.B: "Vương quốc thiên đàng giống như chuyện một vị vua kia làm tiệc cưới cho con trai mình.
vi.R: "Vương quốc thiên đàng giống như chuyện sau đây. Có một vị vua tổ chức một bữa tiệc cưới lớn cho con trai mình.

ko.L: "천국은 자기 아들을 위하여 혼인 잔치를 베푼 어떤 사람, 곧 왕에게 비유되었다.
ko.B: "천국은 자기 아들의 혼인 잔치를 베푼 어떤 왕의 이야기와 같다.
ko.R: "천국은 이런 일과 같다. 어떤 왕이 자기 아들의 결혼을 축하하려고 큰 잔치를 열었다.

pt.L: "O Reino dos céus se tornou semelhante a um homem, um rei, que fez uma festa de casamento para o seu filho.
pt.B: "O que acontece no Reino dos céus pode ser comparado a isto: um rei preparou um banquete de casamento para o seu filho.
pt.R: "O Reino dos céus é como esta história. Um rei deu uma grande festa de casamento para o seu filho.

am.L: «መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለልጁ ሰርግ ያደረገን ንጉሥ የሆነ ሰው መሰለች።
am.B: «በመንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚሆነው ነገር እንዲህ ሊመሰል ይችላል፤ አንድ ንጉሥ ለልጁ የሰርግ ግብዣ አዘጋጀ።

ru.B: «Вот с чем можно сравнить то, что происходит в Царстве Небесном: один царь устроил свадебный пир для своего сына.
ru.R: «Небесное Царство похоже вот на что. Один царь устроил большой свадебный праздник для своего сына.

hi.L: "स्वर्ग का राज्य एक मनुष्य, एक राजा के समान हो गया है, जिसने अपने पुत्र के लिए विवाह का भोज दिया।
